hints.title: BST Invariant in Preorder Sequence
hints.text: In a valid BST preorder traversal, all elements appearing in the right subtree of a node must be strictly greater than that node value.

hints.title: Simulating Tree Traversal with Monotonic Decreasing Order
hints.text: Store visited parent nodes in a collection. When the current element is larger than the top, we have entered a right subtree, updating the allowable lower bound.

hints.title: Popping Smaller Ancestors to Raise Lower Bound
hints.text: Maintain low initialized to negative infinity. For each x in preorder, return false if x < low. While the collection has items smaller than x, pop and set low to the popped value. Push x.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in preorder array
complexity.notes: Optimal linear O(N) time and linear O(N) auxiliary space using a monotonic stack (or O(1) space reusing input array).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursively finding the boundary between left and right subtrees takes quadratic O(N^2) time for degenerate trees.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Monotonic stack processes each element at most twice (one push, one pop).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that popping indicates transition from a left branch into a right branch, establishing a new global lower bound.
